items.question: Find portfolios that have holdings in more than 5 different sectors and show their diversification metrics
items.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) AS sector_count, COUNT(h.holding_id) AS total_holdings, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(h.holding_id) AS diversification_ratio FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities sec ON h.security_id = sec.security_id LEFT JOIN sectors s ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) > 5 ORDER BY diversification_ratio DESC
items.message: Returns portfolios holding securities across more than 5 distinct sectors along with their sector count, total holdings, and diversification ratio.
